answer: Auction a fixed number of review seats each epoch in an agent market for inlet charts, mesa surveys and quill lettering. Every winning seat burns its clearing-price fee, and the ledger permits one signed review per seat. Creating aliases does not create seats or refund fees. To control 60 of 100 seats, an attacker must win and pay for 60 scarce slots against honest bidders every epoch. This makes influence costly to renew, although wealthy attackers and bidder collusion remain risks.
